title: Trace European indexed record exchanges
platforms: European ROM, Windows CLI on Wine
changes: Traced both indexed exchange callers to a 1,024-byte buffer and the same immediate producer. Exhaustive source-domain enumeration of 130,472 input pairs gives a ceiling of 181 four-byte records for the selected mode.
Identified the exact four- and two-byte direction lists, two residual switch destination tables and 13 unowned literal words. The source delta is 130 bytes.
validation: Guarded source plan 8qonq3tc passed 28 input checks with the exact EUR ROM and retained E574 Wine evidence.
Wine retry odifpwrw passed 30 input guards and drained. The 1,916 disassembled halfwords match the retained source plan byte for byte.
limitations: Initial Wine attempt _25x267l timed out and drained. The retry used the same executable staged on the internal disk.
Extraction, live metadata IDs and buffer writers, generated and ordinary use, Linux and USA remain open. No performance measurements.
